block.projectexpansion.transmutation_int: This can be used with compatible mods like Applied Energistics to access your transmutation inventory.
block.projectexpansion.compact_sun.toolt: The power of the sun in a single block.
When put above or below certain blocks, multiplies their output by %s.
block.projectexpansion.condenser_mk3.too: 5 Condensers in one, each side (except down) is a separate condenser with its own input, processing, and lock slot. The down side is the output for all other sides.
